verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a first-party Triggers feature for setting up workflows and automations that execute business processes, created from premade templates or from scratch. This is a product-native rules-and-actions engine, but the evidence is thin on detail. Missing for 10: documented list of trigger events, conditions and available actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Set up complex workflows and automations to execute your business processes
Once you hit "create trigger" you'll have the option to select from various premade templates or start from scratch.
